import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu'; import { Fn, If, instancedArray, instanceIndex, float, vec2, select } from 'three/tsl'; // Triangle vertices (in 0-1 normalized space) const triangle = [ { x: 0.5, y: 0.1 }, // A (bottom) { x: 0.15, y: 0.85 }, // B (top-left) { x: 0.85, y: 0.85 }, // C (top-right) ]; // Generate random test points const numPoints = 100; const points = []; for (let i = 0; i < numPoints; i++) { points.push({ x: Math.random(), y: Math.random() }); } // Draw initial state const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas'); const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); function drawScene(results = null) { const w = canvas.width; const h = canvas.height; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); // Draw triangle ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(triangle[0].x * w, (1 - triangle[0].y) * h); ctx.lineTo(triangle[1].x * w, (1 - triangle[1].y) * h); ctx.lineTo(triangle[2].x * w, (1 - triangle[2].y) * h); ctx.closePath(); ctx.strokeStyle = '#4fc3f7'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.1)'; ctx.fill(); // Draw triangle vertices for (const v of triangle) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(v.x * w, (1 - v.y) * h, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fillStyle = '#81c784'; ctx.fill(); } // Draw points for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) { const p = points[i]; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x * w, (1 - p.y) * h, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); if (results === null) { ctx.fillStyle = '#666'; // Unknown } else if (results[i]) { ctx.fillStyle = '#81c784'; // Inside } else { ctx.fillStyle = '#ef5350'; // Outside } ctx.fill(); } } drawScene(); // Initial draw without results window.runExample = async function() { const output = document.getElementById('output'); output.innerHTML = 'Initializing...'; try { const renderer = new THREE.WebGPURenderer(); await renderer.init(); output.innerHTML = '✓ WebGPU ready\n'; // Prepare triangle data (3 vertices as vec4 for alignment) const triangleData = new Float32Array([ triangle[0].x, triangle[0].y, 0, 0, triangle[1].x, triangle[1].y, 0, 0, triangle[2].x, triangle[2].y, 0, 0, ]); // Prepare points data const pointsData = new Float32Array(numPoints * 4); for (let i = 0; i < numPoints; i++) { pointsData[i * 4 + 0] = points[i].x; pointsData[i * 4 + 1] = points[i].y; pointsData[i * 4 + 2] = 0; pointsData[i * 4 + 3] = 0; } // Create buffers const triangleBuffer = instancedArray(triangleData, 'vec4'); const pointsBuffer = instancedArray(pointsData, 'vec4'); const resultsBuffer = instancedArray(new Uint32Array(numPoints), 'uint'); // Compute shader: point in triangle test const pointInTriangleKernel = Fn(() => { // Load point const point = pointsBuffer.element(instanceIndex).xy; // Load triangle vertices const a = triangleBuffer.element(0).xy; const b = triangleBuffer.element(1).xy; const c = triangleBuffer.element(2).xy; // Sign function: which side of edge (a,b) is point p on? // sign > 0: left side, sign < 0: right side const sign = (px, py, ax, ay, bx, by) => { return (px.sub(bx)).mul(ay.sub(by)).sub((ax.sub(bx)).mul(py.sub(by))); }; const d1 = sign(point.x, point.y, a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y); const d2 = sign(point.x, point.y, b.x, b.y, c.x, c.y); const d3 = sign(point.x, point.y, c.x, c.y, a.x, a.y); // Point is inside if all signs are same (all ≥0 or all ≤0) const hasNeg = d1.lessThan(0).or(d2.lessThan(0)).or(d3.lessThan(0)); const hasPos = d1.greaterThan(0).or(d2.greaterThan(0)).or(d3.greaterThan(0)); // Inside = NOT (has both positive and negative) const inside = hasNeg.and(hasPos).not(); // Store result: 1 if inside, 0 if outside resultsBuffer.element(instanceIndex).assign(select(inside, 1, 0)); })().compute(numPoints); output.innerHTML += `\nTesting ${numPoints} points against triangle...\n`; // Execute await renderer.computeAsync(pointInTriangleKernel); // Read results const resultBuffer = await renderer.getArrayBufferAsync(resultsBuffer.value); const results = new Uint32Array(resultBuffer); // Count inside/outside let insideCount = 0; const boolResults = []; for (let i = 0; i < numPoints; i++) { boolResults.push(results[i] === 1); if (results[i] === 1) insideCount++; } output.innerHTML += `\nPoints inside: ${insideCount}`; output.innerHTML += `\nPoints outside: ${numPoints - insideCount}`; // Verify with CPU (optional) function cpuPointInTriangle(p, a, b, c) { const sign = (p, a, b) => (p.x - b.x) * (a.y - b.y) - (a.x - b.x) * (p.y - b.y); const d1 = sign(p, a, b); const d2 = sign(p, b, c); const d3 = sign(p, c, a); const hasNeg = (d1 < 0) || (d2 < 0) || (d3 < 0); const hasPos = (d1 > 0) || (d2 > 0) || (d3 > 0); return !(hasNeg && hasPos); } let mismatches = 0; for (let i = 0; i < numPoints; i++) { const cpuResult = cpuPointInTriangle(points[i], triangle[0], triangle[1], triangle[2]); if (cpuResult !== boolResults[i]) mismatches++; } if (mismatches === 0) { output.innerHTML += `\n\n✓ All ${numPoints} results match CPU verification!`; } else { output.innerHTML += `\n\n✗ ${mismatches} mismatches with CPU`; } // Update visualization drawScene(boolResults); renderer.dispose(); } catch (error) { output.innerHTML += `\n✗ Error: ${error.message}`; console.error(error); } };
